Board of Directors |url=https://www.royalorchidhotels.com/royal-orchid-group}}{{cite news |title=Lilian Jessie Paul, 49, Independent Non-Executive Director, Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. |url=https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/IN/XNSE/ROHLTD/company-people/executive-profile/136059478 |publisher=[[The Wall Street Journal]]}} [[CreditAccess Grameen Limited|CreditAccess Grameen]].{{cite news |title=CreditAccess Grameen Intimation Of Appointment Of Independent Directors |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/creditaccess-grameen-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-31253.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]]}} ==Education and personal life== She started her education at a convent in Delhi, did 2nd to 5th grade in Sydney, Australia, and completed her schooling from an all girls school in her native village of [[Nazareth, Tamil Nadu|Nazareth]], [[Tamil Nadu]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.kidskintha.com/cutting-through-clutter-and-raising-the-bar-meet-jessie-paul/|title=Cutting Through Clutter And Raising the Bar - Meet Jessie Paul|date=2016-03-31|website=Kidskintha|language=en-US|access-date=2019-08-27|archive-date=27 August 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190827153822/https://www.kidskintha.com/cutting-through-clutter-and-raising-the-bar-meet-jessie-paul/|url-status=dead}}{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=99yCpqaupNcC&q=jessie+paul+schooling&pg=PT24|title=Breaking Barriers|last=Krishnan|first=Janaki|date=2013|publisher=Jaico Publishing House|isbn=9788184953954|language=en}} Paul holds a bachelor's degree in computer science and an engineering degree from [[National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli]]{{cite web|title=Jessie Paul, Managing Director, Paul Writer|url=http://www.nasscom.in/sites/default/files/Speakers/Jessie_Paul.pdf|publisher=[[NASSCOM]]|access-date=19 February 2017|archive-date=20 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170220172255/http://www.nasscom.in/sites/default/files/Speakers/Jessie_Paul.pdf|url-status=dead}} and an [[Master of Business Administration|MBA]] in marketing from [[Indian Institute of Management Calcutta]].{{cite web|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/person.asp?personId=22583671&privcapId=209503804&previousCapId=209503804&previousTitle=Gaglers,%20Inc. |title=Executive profile — Jessie Paul |work=Bloomberg |access-date=13 January 2017}} Paul is married, with one daughter, and resides in [[Bengaluru]], India. ==Career== After graduating from NIT, she joined the technology design firm, Tata Elxsi, as a trainer and part of the sales support team. Paul had worked for almost 15 years in companies including O&M, [[Infosys]] and [[IGATE|iGate]].{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/wipros-cmo-jessie-paul-quits-to-start-own-venture/articleshow/5213972.cms|title=Wipro's CMO Jessie Paul quits to start own venture|last=Singh|first=Shelley|date=2009-11-10|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-08-27}} In 1998, Paul worked at Infosys as a Global Brand Manager. Her role included heading the set up of the company's marketing team and field marketing programs like the Wharton Infosys Business Transformation Award, which she anchored. During her time, Infosys also received the US-based IT Services Marketing Association’s Diamond Award. She was also part of the team which was involved in the [[NASDAQ]] listing of Infosys’ American Depositary Shares in 1999. Paul left [[Infosys]] to join a start-up back-office firm Quintant Corporation in 2003 as its Global Marketing Head. Quintant was soon after acquired by iGate Corp where she then worked for two years. In 2005, Paul became chief marketing officer and led a team of 50 at [[Wipro]].{{cite web|url=http://www.ciol.com/News/Executive-Track/News-Reports/Wipros-CMO-Jessie-Paul-steps-down/101109127510/0/|title=Wipro's CMO Jessie Paul steps down|author=Akanksha Prasad|date=10 November 2009|publisher=CyberMedia India Online Ltd., CIOL|accessdate=23 July 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120406044035/http://www.ciol.com/News/Executive-Track/News-Reports/Wipros-CMO-Jessie-Paul-steps-down/101109127510/0/|archive-date=6 April 2012|url-status=dead}} Paul quit Wipro Technologies in 2009 to start her own venture, Paul Writer Strategic Advisory.{{cite news|publisher=[[The Economic Times]]|title=Can Cocofly crack the 'Paper Boat Problem'?|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/brand-equity/can-cocofly-crack-the-paper-boat-problem/articleshow/56889875.cms}}{{cite news |title='Frameworks have been super handy' - Jessie Paul, CEO, Paul Writer |url=https://bloncampus.thehindubusinessline.com/placement-prep/frameworks-have-been-super-handy/article32774096.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]]}}{{cite web|title=Jessie Paul: Creating An Indian B2B Community|url=http://www.womensweb.in/articles/interview-with-jessie-paul/|access-date=19 February 2017|archive-date=20 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170220092435/http://www.womensweb.in/articles/interview-with-jessie-paul/|url-status=dead}} Paul has been named one of the most influential women in information technology in India.{{cite web|title=No Money Marketing Jessie Paul >About the Author|work=Tata Mcgraw Hill|url=http://www.tatamcgrawhill.com/html/9780070152700.html|accessdate=23 July 2010}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.digitalvidya.com/blog/expert/jessie-paul/|title=Jessie Paul - extract:
Jessie Paul is an Indian marketer, founder and CEO of a marketing advisory firm, public speaker, and author. She was chief marketing officer of Wipro IT Business and global brand manager at Infosys.
Paul is a non-executive director with SQS India BFSI Limited, Expleo Solutions, Bajaj Consumer Care, Royal Orchid Hotels, CreditAccess Grameen.
